tasks.short: Supervise sociology laboratory and field work.

steps.what: Retrieve actual student field/laboratory plans, research permissions and supervision requirements
inputs: actual student plans and work
actual field/laboratory requirements and permissions

steps.what: Supervise actual students' laboratory and field work and assess practice and understanding
inputs: checked actual supervision context
actual observed student activity and questions
outputs: actual supervision observations and chosen feedback

steps.what: Record and check actual supervision observations and feedback using native student fields
inputs: actual supervision observations and chosen feedback

steps.what: Save the checked actual laboratory/field supervision record
inputs: checked final actual supervision record

tasks.design: Configure native student-plan links and supervision fields in {LMS}, {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. Retain actual observation, participant-sensitive judgement and feedback capture/check, with only repeated identifiers/headings reduced before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision can repeat plan navigation and stable student record fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and record fields can reduce repetitive administration.
tasks.still_hard: Responsible field/laboratory supervision needs actual observation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises inappropriate field practice or misunderstanding needing immediate support.
tasks.altitude: Less record administration; supervision stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native student-plan links and record fields can support supervision administration; they do not observe or assess sociology field practice.

assumptions: Actual students/course owners supply plans and permissions, checked in s1. Teacher observes actual work and chooses feedback in s2. Retained s3 captures new observations/feedback and performs complete final checking; no free observation data.

S3 cuts repeated identifiers/headings only. Actual record branch applies only where required; otherwise remove and reweight rather than invent notes. Any actual written feedback delivery is its own exact-final-version gated send, with no avoided send time here.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native fields first; existing prefill earns zero saving. Routine save retains one percent using existing final check.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce entry after complete observation/feedback checks?

already_counted.description: Capture actual supervision meaning and check final record in s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual student-plan links and supervision fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual supervision record and exact student/activity destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 navigation + 14*0.20 repeated fields = 6.8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 6.3. Half eligible gives 3.4 minus 0.5 = 2.9. Actual supervision, new capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks, laboratory equipment and supplies.

steps.what: Find and verify actual textbook/equipment specifications, availability, prices and institutional purchasing requirements
inputs: actual teaching/research material needs
actual vendor/library catalogue records and procurement requirements
outputs: checked actual material options and current terms

steps.what: Select actual materials and supplies appropriate to sociology teaching and laboratory needs
inputs: checked actual material options and current terms
actual educational/research objectives and authorised budget
outputs: actual chosen items, quantities and justified acquisition route

steps.what: Prepare actual order or acquisition request using verified catalogue and teacher-chosen quantities
inputs: actual chosen items, quantities and justified acquisition route
checked actual material options and current terms

steps.what: Check exact final items, quantities, price, destination and actual acquisition authority
inputs: complete actual order/request draft
actual authorised budget and acquisition route
outputs: checked final actual order/request and permitted destination

steps.what: Send exact checked order/request through the actual authorised acquisition route
inputs: checked final actual order/request and permitted destination

steps.what: Obtain actual materials or supplies and inspect delivered items against actual request
inputs: actual delivered items or granted library access
checked final actual order/request and permitted destination

steps.what: Record and check actual receipt, access or unresolved supply discrepancy
inputs: actual received/available materials and discrepancies
outputs: checked final actual acquisition receipt record

steps.what: Commit the checked actual acquisition receipt record
inputs: checked final actual acquisition receipt record

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue search and request fields in {PROCUREMENT}, with actual specifications in {DOCS}. The teacher selects materials, checks exact final acquisition request, separately sends it, then verifies actual receipt/access and commits the checked receipt record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Acquisition can repeat catalogue navigation and item-field entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue fields can reuse verified item terms in an actual request.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching suitability and actual received items require teacher checks.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises a nominal substitute that does not serve the course.
tasks.altitude: Less acquisition typing; selection and receipt checks stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native catalogue/request fields can reduce acquisition navigation and repeated item entry; they do not choose suitable materials or verify delivery.

assumptions: Actual vendor/library owners supply item identifier, edition/specification, price and availability; teacher verifies currentness in s1 and chooses actual quantities in s2. Retained s3 covers new request fields and exceptions; missing terms stay manual.

Actual acquisition route may be purchase, library borrowing or digital access; remove unused order/physical receipt branches and reweight. Teacher sends only within actual authority; otherwise sends an internal request and actual procurement owner retains order approval after final version exists.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native fields first; existing prefill earns zero saving. Actual receipt/access is established by s6, not planned order; receipt capture/check remains retained.
Order/request send and receipt commit each retain one percent using existing final checks. No new purchasing authority, assumed vendor fulfilment or avoided owner approval labour.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce request typing after complete item/authority checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual catalogue/request fields and verification checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual items, quantities, terms, actual authority and exact request/order destination; edits void approval
s7 checked final actual receipt/access record and exact acquisition destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 catalogue navigation + 20*0.50 request typing = 18; minus 1 upkeep = 17. Half eligible gives 9 minus 1 = 8. Selection, complete final check, send, actual receipt/capture and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual sociology teaching/research evidence and relevant colleague work
inputs: actual teaching/research issue
actual course/research records and colleague materials

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to address actual teaching and research issues
inputs: checked actual collaboration sources
actual colleague observations and questions
outputs: actual shared analysis and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Record and check actual agreed teaching/research follow-up where written record is required
inputs: actual shared analysis and agreed follow-up
outputs: checked final actual collaboration record and permitted recipients

steps.what: Save the checked actual collaboration follow-up record
inputs: checked final actual collaboration record and permitted recipients

steps.what: Send exact checked written follow-up to actual collaborating colleagues
inputs: checked final actual collaboration record and permitted recipients

tasks.design: Configure native issue/source links in {DOCS}, {LMS} and {PROJECT}. The teacher retains actual collaboration and agreement capture/check, then separately saves and delivers any actual written follow-up.
tasks.previous_blocker: Collaboration preparation can repeat source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native issue/source links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving teaching/research issues requires collegial reasoning and agreement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises when different interpretations need discussion rather than a standard recommendation.
tasks.altitude: Less collaboration lookup; collegial work stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native issue/source links can support collaboration preparation; they do not resolve teaching or research issues.

assumptions: Actual course/research owners and colleagues supply source work; teacher checks it in s1. Actual discussion, scientific/teaching decisions and new follow-up capture remain retained.
Record/delivery branches only where actual; informal oral collaboration removes them and reweights rather than inventing minutes. Preparation counted once per actual issue, not per colleague.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent using existing final check. Shared committee/material work is counted once.
research_questions: Can native links shorten preparation while preserving collaboration?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual collaboration record and exact internal destination; edits require recheck
s3 checked final actual follow-up and exact authorised colleagues; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 source navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Actual collaboration, capture/check and actions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on institutional and academic committees.

steps.what: Find and check actual committee agenda, policy versions and departmental/academic papers
inputs: actual committee remit and agenda
actual institutional policies and academic evidence

steps.what: Serve on committees addressing actual institutional policies, departmental matters and academic issues
inputs: checked actual committee sources
actual member discussion and institutional constraints
outputs: actual committee contribution and agreed actions

steps.what: Record and check actual assigned committee action or note where required
inputs: actual committee contribution and agreed actions
outputs: checked final actual assigned committee record

steps.what: Save the checked actual assigned committee record
inputs: checked final actual assigned committee record

tasks.design: Configure native committee agenda/policy links in {DOCS}. The teacher retains substantive reading, actual committee participation and any assigned note/action capture/check, with a separate record save in {DOCS} or {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Committee preparation can repeat current-paper navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native agenda/policy links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises student and departmental consequences that are absent from a standard paper summary.
tasks.altitude: Less current-paper lookup; committee work stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native committee-paper links can support preparation; they do not deliberate or establish institutional decisions.

assumptions: Actual committee/policy owners supply agenda and current papers; teacher checks sources in s1. All substantive reading, deliberation and actual assigned record capture remain retained.

Record applies only if teacher actually owns a note/action, not mandatory minutes per member. Otherwise omit branch and reweight; chair/secretary labour is not invented. Shared collaboration under 6086 counted once.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing paper access earns zero saving. Routine save retains one percent using existing final check. Any actual distribution/formal decision record must be separately final-content gated, with no avoided labour assumed.
research_questions: Can native links reduce retrieval while preserving full committee preparation?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual assigned committee record and exact permitted destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 paper navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Deliberation, actual assigned record and save retained.

role.altitude: Sociology teachers retain student supervision and collegial judgement while actual preparation and purchase entry may shrink.
